lumia.isConnected.description: Checks whether Cuebot is connected to Lumia Stream right now.

lumia.connect.description: Starts connecting to Lumia Stream. It does not wait: Cuebot keeps trying in the background until it works.
lumia.connect.returns: true once connecting has started (not when it is connected).

lumia.sendCommand.description: Runs one of your Lumia Stream commands, like a light scene. Fails with an error when Lumia Stream is not connected or says no.

parameters.command: The command's name as set in Lumia Stream, like "party". Needed.
parameters.type: Optional. The kind of command: "chat-command", "chatbot-command", "twitch-points", "twitch-extension" or "kick-points". Default "chat-command".
parameters.hold: Optional. true keeps the lights this way afterwards instead of going back. Default false.
parameters.skipQueue: Optional. true runs it right away instead of waiting in Lumia's queue. Default false.
parameters.extraSettings: Optional. Extra values for the command, like {"username": "CoolViewer"}.

lumia.sendCommand.returns: true when Lumia Stream accepted it.

lumia.setToDefault.description: Puts your Lumia Stream lights back to their default look.
lumia.setToDefault.returns: true when Lumia Stream accepted it.

lumia.setColor.description: Changes the colour of your Lumia Stream lights. Fails with an error when Lumia Stream is not connected.

parameters.color: The colour as "#RRGGBB", like "#FF4076", or "r,g,b", like "255,64,118". Needed.
parameters.transition: Optional. How long the colour fades in, in milliseconds.
parameters.duration: Optional. How long the colour stays, in milliseconds.
parameters.lights: Optional. Which lights, by name or id, split with commas, like "Hue go, hue:19". Leave it out for all lights.
parameters.hold: Optional. true keeps this colour afterwards instead of going back. Default false.
parameters.skipQueue: Optional. true does it right away instead of waiting in Lumia's queue. Default false.

lumia.setColor.returns: true when Lumia Stream accepted it.

lumia.sendAlert.description: Fakes a Lumia Stream alert, like a follow, so its light show plays. Fails with an error when Lumia Stream is not connected.

parameters.alert: The alert's name in Lumia Stream, like "twitch-follower". Needed.
parameters.extraSettings: Optional. Extra values for the alert, like {"username": "CoolViewer"}.

lumia.sendAlert.returns: true when Lumia Stream accepted it.

lumia.chatbotMessage.description: Sends a chat message through Lumia Stream's chat bot. Fails with an error when Lumia Stream is not connected.

parameters.message: What to say, like "The lights are now purple!" Needed.
parameters.platform: Optional. Where to send it: "twitch", "youtube", "facebook", "kick", "discord" or "all". Default "twitch".
parameters.asSelf: Optional. true sends it as your own account instead of the bot. Default false.

lumia.chatbotMessage.returns: true when Lumia Stream accepted it.

lumia.tts.description: Says text out loud with Lumia Stream's text-to-speech. Fails with an error when Lumia Stream is not connected.

parameters.message: What to say, like "Welcome to the stream!" Needed.
parameters.voice: Optional. The Lumia voice name. Leave it out for Lumia's default voice.

lumia.tts.returns: true when Lumia Stream accepted it.

lumia.getVariable.description: Reads one of your Lumia Stream variables. Fails with an error when Lumia Stream is not connected.

parameters.name: The variable's name in Lumia Stream, like "deaths". Needed.

lumia.getVariable.returns: The variable's value as text (empty when Lumia sends nothing).

lumia.setVariable.description: Changes one of your Lumia Stream variables. Fails with an error when Lumia Stream is not connected.

parameters.name: The variable's name in Lumia Stream, like "deaths". Needed.
parameters.value: The new value: text, a number, true/false or an object. Counters also take "+1", "-1" or "=5".

lumia.setVariable.returns: true when Lumia Stream accepted it.

lumia.send.description: Sends any request to Lumia Stream's Send API. For advanced users who know Lumia's request types.

parameters.params: Optional. The request's settings as an object, like {"value": "Sunset"}.

lumia.send.returns: Lumia Stream's reply message, or null when it sends none.

lumia.getInfo.description: Tells you what your Lumia Stream offers: its commands, alerts, lights and voices. Cuebot reads this when it connects.
lumia.getInfo.returns: commands (names by kind), alerts, lights (each with id, name, type), voices and states (on, streamMode, fuze; or null).
